Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points: knowledge of data warehousing and data lakes, hands-on SQL experience, Python knowledge, experience with GCP or another cloud provider, and willingness to research business logic.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
